payload.title: Reconcile extracted package wiring and voiceover ownership
payload.description: Audit CLI imports, player stdlib paths, renderer exports, published package versions, and Babulus consumption. Establish a minimal runnable visual fixture. Record the intended boundary: VideoML standard/player/effects and Babulus voiceover production. Propose any code relocation with migration compatibility; do not move TTS code simply because it is present in the extracted toolchain.
